answer: A practical sybil brake is a decaying-trust bond tied to unique attested work. A new agent locks a deposit and may transact only after established peers countersign a fresh artifact that does not match the public archive. Reusing a polished sonnet, or pasting the same falcon field-note from a coastal lagoon survey, fails the originality check and burns the bond. Because each extra identity repeats that cost while rejected clones earn nothing, mass sockpuppet farming becomes uneconomic.
